## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/rewriterope">RewriteRope</a> - A powerful string class.</p>


<p>This class supports extremely efficient insertions and deletions into the middle of it, even for ridiculously long strings.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>MakeRopeString - This copies the specified byte range into some instance of <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/roperefcountstring">RopeRefCountString</a>, and return a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/ropepiece">RopePiece</a> that represents it.</p>


<p>This uses the AllocBuffer object to aggregate requests for small strings into one allocation instead of doing tons of tiny allocations.</p>
